description: BMDRM Player is a secure Android video player SDK for streaming DRM-protected content, built on Jetpack Media3 (ExoPlayer). It plays Widevine-encrypted DASH streams as well as plain DASH, HLS and progressive video. Playback sessions are resolved from your backend and every media URL is signed on the fly with a per-session ECDSA key, so links cannot be shared or replayed. Anti-piracy features include static and dynamic on-screen watermarking that traces screen recordings back to a user, plus device integrity checks for rooted devices, attached debuggers, tracers, Frida instrumentation and RWX memory, reported to your app with optional playback blocking. The bundled player UI adds an in-player quality selector driven by the stream's own renditions, playback speed control, landscape fullscreen with an optional side drawer, and resume with a continue-watching list. Playback metrics are reported to the BMDRM edge. This is the native Android counterpart of the bmdrm_mobile Flutter plugin. Requires Android 6.0 (API 23) or newer.
